title: Movie Recommendation System
summary: Find your next favourite film with personalized recommendations based on movie content and cosine similarity.
points: Built a content based recommendation system that helps users discover movies similar to their selected film.
Processed movie genres, keywords, cast and crew to identify meaningful similarities between films.
Applied TF-IDF vectorization and cosine similarity to represent movie content numerically and compare movies.
Ranked movies by similarity to recommend five related films for each selection.
Integrated the TMDB API to display movie posters alongside recommendations.
Deployed the application with Streamlit so users can explore recommendations online.
